text: Dr. Eve is lovely. She gave good advice and used the right words with us, making us feel safe talking to her. I'm completely cured now. Thank you very much.

I received treatment here and have recovered a lot. The doctor took excellent care of me, and the staff were lovely. The clinic is located right on the main road, easy to find, and clean and tidy inside.

I took my child to their first psychotherapy appointment. I understood that for the first meeting, we needed to explain the background and cause of the problem so the psychologist could understand and give appropriate advice.

Before I knew it, we were charged 625 baht for an extra 25 minutes, without any warning from the staff or the psychologist.
I'm really annoyed.

I probably won't come back.

The location of the Pattaya clinic is a bit sketchy to visit as it's only open at night and located on the third floor of an otherwise completely empty office building in a dark area of town. However, aside from that the service is really good and the prices are reasonable, or at least competitive compared with other clinics. The receptionist is quick to respond via Line, the process is made very simple and most psychiatric medicines are available here. I found this clinic easier to communicate with and receive help from effectively, more-so than any other local health clinics.
The doctor provided advice and guidance like a family member. Communication and requesting advice were easy and quick, and talking to them made me feel very comfortable.
